name: Uttik AI Answer Engine
author: honeytech

sections.description:
Uttik AI Answer Engine helps WordPress websites answer customer questions clearly, consistently, and at scale.

The plugin connects your website with the Uttik platform to power an AI-driven FAQ and support layer. It enables you to generate FAQs from your website content, organize them into a centralized knowledge system, and automatically apply Schema.org markup so search engines and AI answer engines can better understand your content.

Uttik is designed for websites that want to reduce repetitive support queries, improve FAQ coverage, and maintain a single source of truth for answers.

A valid Uttik Organization ID is required to use this plugin.

Why Use Uttik

  • Centralize answers using a structured Knowledge Vault
  • Generate FAQs using AI based on real content and queries
  • Automatically apply Schema.org FAQPage markup
  • Provide instant answers through widgets and smart chat
  • Learn from user questions to continuously improve content

Core Features

AI FAQ Generation
Generate and refine FAQs using AI based on your website content and user intent.

Knowledge Vault
Create a centralized knowledge base by importing your website sitemap or pages.

Schema.org Automation
Automatically generates FAQPage structured data to improve search visibility and eligibility for rich results.

FAQ Customization
Control how FAQs are displayed to match your site’s layout and branding.

Analytics Dashboard
Track FAQ engagement, usage patterns, and unanswered queries.

Support Queries
Capture real user questions and identify content gaps that need answers.

Smart Chat Support
Provide instant, AI-assisted answers through an embedded smart chat experience.

Getting Started

Quick Start Guide

  1. Install Uttik AI Answer Engine from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Uttik AI FAQ > FAQ Widget Settings and get your Uttik Organization ID from
    https://uttik.com
  4. In your Uttik dashboard, create your first Knowledge Vault by importing your website sitemap.
  5. Copy the Organization ID and paste it into the plugin settings to complete setup.

Helpful Resources

All Features Overview
Explore all Uttik capabilities and modules.

Frequently Asked Questions
Common questions about Uttik functionality and usage.

Help Guides & Documentation
Product guides, setup tutorials, and best practices.

Case Study

HONOR India – Customer Support & Brand Reputation
Learn how Uttik was used to structure answers and improve support workflows.

Video Overview – See Uttik Dashboard Guide in Action

External Services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services:

Uttik API
Used to fetch FAQs, AI-generated answers, knowledge vault data, and analytics.
Terms of Service: https://uttik.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://uttik.com/privacy-policy

Google
Used for sitemap pinging to improve FAQ discovery.
Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Bing
Used for sitemap pinging to improve FAQ indexing.
Terms: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/servicesagreement/
Privacy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-us/privacystatement
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/uttik-answer-engine, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Uttik AI FAQ and enter your Uttik Organization ID.
  4. Use the [uttik_faq_widget] shortcode to display FAQs anywhere on your site.
